title: Human Superintelligence Readiness Index (HSRI) 2.0: The Sovereignty Sentinel, Verification Latency Wedge, and Dual-Layer Architecture
description: Comprehensive empirical benchmark, Dual-Layer Sovereignty Engine, and live telemetry precursor seismograph for national preparedness under advanced AI (v2.0.0 release). Formalizes the Dual-Layer Architecture (Layer 1 Adoption Baseline vs. Layer 2 ASI Sovereignty Leontief Floor beta=0.5), the Verification Latency Wedge Accelerometer, the Cognitive Oversight Richter Scale (CORS 1.0-10.0), and three continuous precursor streams (Autonomy Seismometer, Latent Drift Detector, Verification Wedge). Harmonizes 780 macro observations across 39 benchmark nations exposing High-Compute Vulnerability Traps, JRC Step 7 Monte Carlo audits (W=0.9986), 14 observable ASI precursor tripwires, and the Civilizational Air-Gap Decoupling Simulator.
